record.summary: The repository ships a public documentation website built with Docusaurus v3 under website/, and a GitHub Pages deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml) that builds and publishes it on every push to main touching website/**. The site is authored content (getting-started, concepts, architecture, the spec-spine workflow, platform, OPC desktop, security, and reference sections) rendered as a static site; it is a reader-facing surface, not a source of machine truth. This spec gives that website and its deploy pipeline an owning spec so both trace under the spec-code coupling gate (127) and the workflow-to-spec traceability convention (118), closing the gap where a 62-file feature and a CI workflow had shipped with no governing spec.
record.title: Documentation website (Docusaurus v3) on GitHub Pages
